title: Web Registration System
text:
WEB REGISTRATION OVERVIEW
- Web Registration is the system for registering for or updating semester classes.
- Students choose one of three semesters, then click the current semester to update their schedule or a future semester to register for upcoming courses.

LOGIN
- URL: webreg.usc.edu
- Log in with your USC NetID and password, or open the link from your Experience USC portal (experience.usc.edu).

REGISTRATION APPOINTMENTS
- The myInfo tab's "Registration Appointment" section shows the date and time allotted for your semester registration.

ADDING AND REGISTERING
- Click "Add to myCourseBin" to add a course. Adding a course does not register you for it.
- Review courses in myCourseBin, which lists them as "Scheduled but Not Registered," then click "Register" to open Checkout.
- Obtain D-clearance for any course that requires it and check for time conflicts before registering.
- Unscheduling places a course on hold without reserving a seat. You can unschedule and keep the course in your bin, or unschedule and remove it.

DROPPING AND WITHDRAWING
- Drops during the first three weeks of the semester do not generate a "W" on your transcript, and no tuition is charged for those courses.
- You can withdraw without academic penalty until the 80 percent mark of a session. After that, withdrawal is not permitted and may result in a "W."
- To withdraw officially, click "Drop" after unscheduling. Unscheduling alone leaves your name on the roster and may cause tuition charges and a transcript mark.
- Check Checkout before dropping, because checking out processes all pending changes.
- Review dates on the Registration Calendar (arr.usc.edu/academic-calendar/).

GRADE OPTIONS
- Letter grading is the default. Audit or Pass/No Pass may require instructor permission and is subject to limits. Tuition is the same regardless of grade option.

CONTACTS
- Office of Academic Records and Registrar: arr.usc.edu; contact page arr.usc.edu/contact-us/
- Phone: 213-740-2311 (University Park Campus).
- Schedule questions: contact your advisor.
- Technical issues: USC Information Technology Services (itservices.usc.edu).

NOT ON THIS PAGE: holds and waitlist rules (see the Registration Calendar and the Registrar's other pages).
